title: Plate rolling machines
subtitle: 4R HSS heavy-duty, 4R HS-L linear and 4R HS orbital 4-roll plate rolls · 4RH cassette rolls · 4R HC conical rolls · 3R UHS and 3R HS 3-roll plate rolls
about_title: Four-roll and three-roll plate rolls for shells, tanks, stacks and cones
about_text: The machines in this catalogue are NovoTech's premium line: built in Turkey to NovoTech's specification by a CE-certified metal-forming plant with more than 40 years of machine building and exports to over 100 countries, with European hydraulic and electrical components, inspected before shipping, and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts and technical support from NovoTech in Mississauga, Ontario.

A four-roll plate roll pinches the plate between the top and bottom rolls and bends it with the two side rolls, so the sheet is pre-bent at both ends and rolled into a shell in one pass without a flat end — the 4R HSS heavy-duty machines with an NC console and hydraulic drop-end roll plate to 10 ft and more, the 4R HS-L and 4R HS are the linear and orbital versions for the general fabricator, the 4RH cassette rolls serve the sheet-metal shop and the 4R HC rolls cones on cone-machined rolls. The three-roll 3R UHS translating heavy-duty and 3R HS hydraulic plate rolls take thicker plate at a lower price. Overhead cranes, hydraulic side supports, cone-bending devices and digital readouts are options across the range.
